name: 男童撞色条纹印花短袖牛仔五分裤两件套款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清是一整套而不是单件上衣，用干净平摊抢点击并满足白底主图合规。
主图一秒法则：把这套外穿两件套的头号利益在首屏一次讲完，同时靠颈部以下裁切规避儿童面容。
shots.textZone: the chalk-line rectangle at the upper left holds one headline and one subline, one corner wedge sits on its top edge

shots.intent: 放大夏天外穿最真实的两个麻烦：出汗后衣身贴背、牛仔裤膝头越穿越鼓，右屏给出版型解法。
shots.textZone: one short label slot centred under each panel

shots.intent: 用三处做工近摄解释结构与耐穿性，替家长回答领口会不会泄、袖口有没有双线这类问题。
shots.textZone: one label slot under each of the three panels, each set inside a diamond outline cell

shots.intent: 用织纹微距替掉源页的柔软舒适话术：只给纱线圈粒与撞色条纹边界的实物证据，不下任何功效结论。
shots.textZone: one caption slot beside each of the three blank diamond cells along the lower rail

shots.intent: 让家长代入孩子穿着出门活动的状态：围网前景把尺度与活动量讲清楚，面容一律不入镜。
把源页的三档配色一次看全，用挂杆并排替掉平铺宫格，让颜色与款式选择一步到位。
shots.textZone: one short colourway label slot above each hung set

shots.intent: 消掉买大买小的疑虑：结构与量法线描照搬源页逻辑，但所有实测数值一律留空由卖家真实表填。
shots.textZone: row titles beside a stack of value cells that stay blank, one headline slot above the grid

shots.intent: 源页尾屏就是背面离场镜头：用它把后背图位与裤后版型交代清楚，同时给详情页一次呼吸节奏。
降风险：用可核对的实物层叠与留空资质吊牌收信任，不写任何检测、抗菌与成分结论。
shots.textZone: one headline slot above the tag and one short note line under the care band, every credential field left blank

shots.intent: 收口不靠促销：把源页的推荐搭配功能提到末镜，用同场连带与一个空白描边按钮位收尾。
shots.textZone: one headline slot inside the chalk rectangle at the upper left and one rectangular outline button slot beneath the hero set

style.backgroundSystem: seamless cool paper sweep #F6F7F2 for packshot, flat-lay and measurement screens, painted acrylic hard-court floor #2C5F86 with white chalk lines for every worn screen and the pairing close, pine-green coated chain-link fence with bare aluminium posts #1D5C50 as the foreground plane and the rail-wall field, blue-black matte board #14202A reserved for the knit macro; one chalk-line copy frame per screen at most, never a gradient and never a hue outside this list; no outdoor asphalt, no railway ballast, no roller shutter, no furnished interior, no studio cyclorama and no second wall colour
style.direction: cool campus sports-day kids apparel commerce, painted court-line graphic discipline with clean infographic control
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons drawn inside diamond outline cells in blue-black ink #14202A, plus one solid diamond tick used only as a row marker and one empty diamond swatch outline on the colourway rail; no circular icon plates, no round magnifier windows, no circular photo masks, no hexagon cells, no square index chips, no corner-triangle flags, no halftone dot bands, no print crop marks, no scalloped seals and no certificate or badge artwork
style.lightingSystem: cool overcast-daylight key at 6200K from the upper left, large softbox diffusion with a bounce fill on the shadow side, one honest directional shadow lying on the court floor, true contact shadow under every hem and both shoe soles, glancing side light only on the knit macro, no harsh specular hotspot, no warm cast, no rim flash
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool campus sports-day children's apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool paper white #F6F7F2, hard-court blue #2C5F86, pine-green fence mesh #1D5C50 and blue-black ink #14202A, with one product-matched accent supplied at generation time as {accent_color}; cool overcast-daylight lighting at 6200K from the upper left with a large softbox key, bounce fill, one honest directional shadow on the floor and a true contact shadow under every hem; one modern geometric sans-serif plus one narrow condensed weight used only inside the chalk-line copy frame; background system of seamless cool paper sweep #F6F7F2, painted acrylic court floor #2C5F86 with flat white chalk lines, pine-green coated chain-link fence #1D5C50 with bare aluminium posts and blue-black matte board #14202A for the knit macro, with one chalk-line copy frame per screen at most and never a gradient; layout grammar limited to a hairline chalk-line copy rectangle, one 45-degree corner wedge carrying a single short label, dashed chalk rules as dividers, diamond outline icon cells, one die-cut blank hang-tag card with a horizontal slit and one hanging rail row; thin single-weight line icon style in #14202A with no circular magnifier window, no circular photo mask, no hexagon or square icon plate, no corner-triangle flag, no halftone band and no print crop marks; the striped top and the denim short always read as one set at stable scale, every worn frame a generic child body cropped from the neck down or seen from behind so no identifiable face appears, and the chest graphic zone, the slanted chest band and the leg patch zone named structurally and never redrawn; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent hues
no mixed fonts, no brush lettering and no handwritten or retro lettering
no random backgrounds and no outdoor asphalt, railway, shutter or furnished interior outside the court system
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing contact shadows
no mismatched icon styles and no circular, hexagonal or square icon plates
no identifiable child face, no teen or adult proportions and no invented body shape on the garments
no redrawn garment graphics, no legible characters, numerals or years inside any graphic zone
style.presentationRules: the striped top and the denim short always read as one set at one scale, hero scale never shifting more than five percent between screens; every worn frame is a generic child body cropped from the neck down, seen from behind or shot below the shoulders, never an identifiable face; the rectangular chest graphic zone, the slanted band crossing the chest and the small patch zone on the short leg are named structurally, kept square-on and never redrawn; the ribbed neckband, the twin-needle sleeve hem and the gathered elastic waistband stay readable in at least three screens; both pieces appear together whenever the outfit is shown
style.surfaceSystem: sanded painted acrylic court floor #2C5F86 carrying flat white chalk markings, cool paper sweep #F6F7F2 used both as backdrop and as the card stock of every inset, blue-black matte board #14202A under the macro crop; garment faces stay flat, unwrinkled and lint-free, no debris, no scuff marks and no clutter on the floor
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for every Chinese and Latin label plus one narrow condensed weight used only inside the chalk-line copy frame; in-image Chinese always appears as 「{selling_point_N}」 or 「{callout_N}」; headline 28-46pt, subline 14-18pt, label 10-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; no brush lettering, no script, no serif, no outline lettering, no rendered numerals and no wall-signage wording
